question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Esteemed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Prominent)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Esteemed"** means highly regarded, respected, or admired. (सम्मानित)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was esteemed by her peers for her groundbreaking research.
 
 
• **"Prominent"** means important, well-known, or easily noticeable. (प्रमुख)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a prominent figure in the field of environmental conservation.
 
 
• Both "esteemed" and "prominent" convey a sense of importance and recognition, making "prominent" the most appropriate synonym for "esteemed."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Prominent)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Peaceful** (शांत): Free from disturbance; calm or tranquil.
 
 
• **Example:** The countryside was peaceful, with birds chirping and no traffic noise.
 
 

 
• **Large** (बड़ा): Of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity.
 
 
• **Example:** The large auditorium accommodated thousands of guests.
 
 

 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
 
 
• **Example:** She was happy to receive the award for her hard work.
